Subject: Supplier registration + PO acceptance requirements for AcmeHealth (self-bill & split remit)

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement wants to move Redwood onto our vendor registry but we need to confirm a few AP-side requirements before we can issue POs and enable EFT. High level items below — attaching our vendor packet for reference.

Key asks from Acme AP:
- Full vendor enrollment in our portal (fields include legal entity, remit preferences, bank ACH file format)
- PO acceptance: vendor must accept PO via portal hyperlink or via PO-ack email. We can enable automatic PO-ack at the portal level or accept a signed PO acceptance PDF.
- VAT / tax: provide W-9 (for US entity) and VAT parity information if any EU entities are involved.
- Split remit / escrow flow: for this engagement Acme will split payment across two remit accounts (80% Redwood, 20% reseller partner). We need confirmation Redwood can accept a split remit and provide an escrow routing ID.
- Self-billing: we have a self-bill program for specific partners. If Redwood participates, we need signed self-bill agreement and invoice samples matching our XML schema.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
1) Confirm whether you can accept split remit and provide escrow routing/account ID.
2) Share completed vendor packet, tax docs, and a sample invoice (CSV or XML) that maps to the PO reference field.
3) Indicate whether Redwood will join our self-bill program or prefer standard supplier invoicing.

Can you please get back by EOD Thursday so we can schedule portal provisioning next week?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Senior Procurement Manager — Acme Health
